sloka: ईषत्कार्यमिदं कार्यं कृतमासीन्न संशयः ।तस्य क्रोधाभिभूतेन मया मूलक्षयः कृतः ।। 5.55.11 ।।।।
transliteration: īṣatkāryamidaṁ kāryaṁ kṛtamāsīnna saṁśayaḥ ।tasya krodhābhibhūtena mayā mūlakṣayaḥ kṛtaḥ ।। 5.55.11 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Surely Janaki has perished in Lanka, for not even a little place is left unburnt. The entire city is reduced to ashes.
